name: luchaoo7-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Daniel Brown.

plugins.name: project-discovery
plugins.description: Phase-gated discovery for new and existing software projects: takes an idea or codebase to approved PRD, MVP scope, lightweight TRD, UX flows and wireframes, design system and database schema, with a decision log and requirement traceability.

plugins.name: vibe-code-auditor
plugins.description: Audits codebases (especially AI-generated / vibe-coded ones) for bloat, duplication, complexity, dead code, security risks and architecture weaknesses, then produces a prioritised report with before/after refactoring examples and applies only approved changes.
